rows.note: 3,000 standing, 10 Nistlepod, 20,000 cr; the Plague strikes' rank

conditions: Bounty tiers: Standard pays 1,025 and needs nothing; Advanced pays 3,200 and Steel Path 3,800, and each of those needs an Eidolon Phylaxis and an Infested Catalyst in every squad member's inventory.
bonuses: Keeping the escort drone above 80% health adds 25, 75 or 100 by tier.
Each rank-up grants one free item of that rank; the Champion pick can be a Plague strike blueprint, saving its 2,000 standing.
Nakak also sells Cetus Wisps for 750 standing and 1,500 cr each.
